agenda_profile_subjects_paused_consisten.name: agenda_profile_subjects_paused_consistency
agenda_profile_subjects_paused_consisten.value:
("agenda"."profile_subjects"."status" = 'paused' AND "agenda"."profile_subjects"."paused_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("agenda"."profile_subjects"."status" = 'active' AND "agenda"."profile_subjects"."paused_at" IS NULL)

agenda_revision_one_target.name: agenda_revision_one_target
agenda_revision_one_target.value: ("agenda"."activity_revisions"."activity_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("agenda"."activity_revisions"."task_id" IS NOT NULL)

agenda_notification_hours_check.name: agenda_notification_hours_check
agenda_notification_hours_check.value: "agenda"."notification_preferences"."digest_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "agenda"."notification_preferences"."quiet_start" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "agenda"."notification_preferences"."quiet_end" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "agenda"."notification_preferences"."weekly_digest_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "agenda"."notification_preferences"."weekly_digest_day" BETWEEN 0 AND 6

agenda_subject_kit_target_check.name: agenda_subject_kit_target_check
agenda_subject_kit_target_check.value: ("agenda"."subject_kits"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("agenda"."subject_kits"."profile_subject_id" IS NOT NULL)

agenda_task_date_origin_check.name: agenda_task_date_origin_check
agenda_task_date_origin_check.value: ("agenda"."tasks"."due_at" IS NULL AND "agenda"."tasks"."date_origin" = 'unspecified') OR ("agenda"."tasks"."due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agenda"."tasks"."date_origin" IN ('school','relative','family','schedule'))

agenda_task_time_check.name: agenda_task_time_check
agenda_task_time_check.value: "agenda"."tasks"."time" IS NULL OR ("agenda"."tasks"."due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agenda"."tasks"."time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')

ai_operation_receipt_output.name: ai_operation_receipt_output
ai_operation_receipt_output.value: ("ai"."operation_receipts"."result" IS NULL) = ("ai"."operation_receipts"."actual_credits" IS NULL) AND ("ai"."operation_receipts"."phase" NOT IN ('output', 'complete') OR "ai"."operation_receipts"."result" IS NOT NULL)

collection_plan_changes_provider_chk.name: collection_plan_changes_provider_chk
collection_plan_changes_provider_chk.value: "billing"."collection_plan_changes"."provider_schedule_id" IS NULL OR "billing"."collection_plan_changes"."request_started_at" IS NOT NULL

credit_ledger_funding_control.name: credit_ledger_funding_control
credit_ledger_funding_control.value: "billing"."credit_ledger"."entry_type"::text not in ('funding_suspension', 'funding_restoration') or ("billing"."credit_ledger"."source_entry_id" is not null and "billing"."credit_ledger"."source_entry_id" <> "billing"."credit_ledger"."id" and (("billing"."credit_ledger"."entry_type"::text = 'funding_suspension' and "billing"."credit_ledger"."amount" < 0) or ("billing"."credit_ledger"."entry_type"::text = 'funding_restoration' and "billing"."credit_ledger"."amount" > 0)))

credit_purchase_amounts.name: credit_purchase_amounts
credit_purchase_amounts.value: "billing"."credit_purchase_intents"."amount_cents" > 0 and "billing"."credit_purchase_intents"."credits" > 0 and "billing"."credit_purchase_intents"."refunded_amount_cents" between 0 and "billing"."credit_purchase_intents"."amount_cents" and "billing"."credit_purchase_intents"."revoked_credits" between 0 and "billing"."credit_purchase_intents"."credits"

credit_purchase_outcome.name: credit_purchase_outcome
credit_purchase_outcome.value: "billing"."credit_purchase_intents"."outcome" in ('pending', 'paid', 'expired', 'failed') and (("billing"."credit_purchase_intents"."outcome" = 'pending') = ("billing"."credit_purchase_intents"."resolved_at" is null)) and (("billing"."credit_purchase_intents"."outcome" = 'paid') = ("billing"."credit_purchase_intents"."payment_id" is not null))

credit_wallet_migration_entries_destinat.name: credit_wallet_migration_entries_destination_amount
credit_wallet_migration_entries_destinat.value: ("billing"."credit_wallet_migration_entries"."destination_entry_id" is null and "billing"."credit_wallet_migration_entries"."destination_amount" = 0) or ("billing"."credit_wallet_migration_entries"."destination_entry_id" is not null and "billing"."credit_wallet_migration_entries"."destination_amount" <> 0)

sessions_web_lineage.name: sessions_web_lineage
sessions_web_lineage.value:
(
      ("core"."sessions"."origin_app" is null and "core"."sessions"."parent_session_id" is null)
      or ("core"."sessions"."origin_app" = 'conta' and "core"."sessions"."parent_session_id" is null)
      or ("core"."sessions"."origin_app" is not null and length("core"."sessions"."origin_app") > 0 and "core"."sessions"."origin_app" <> 'conta' and "core"."sessions"."parent_session_id" is not null)
    )

estrela_rewards_price.name: estrela_rewards_price
estrela_rewards_price.value: ("dia_de_estrela"."rewards"."kind" = 'custom' and "dia_de_estrela"."rewards"."price_stars" between 1 and 100000 and "dia_de_estrela"."rewards"."money_cents" is null) or ("dia_de_estrela"."rewards"."kind" = 'money' and "dia_de_estrela"."rewards"."money_cents" between 100 and 100000 and "dia_de_estrela"."rewards"."price_stars" is null)

family_person_name_source.name: family_person_name_source
family_person_name_source.value: ("family"."people"."user_id" is null and "family"."people"."display_name" is not null and char_length("family"."people"."display_name") between 1 and 80) or ("family"."people"."user_id" is not null and "family"."people"."display_name" is null)

missao_competition_turn_content.name: missao_competition_turn_content
missao_competition_turn_content.value: ("missao_saber"."competition_turns"."kind" = 'problem' and "missao_saber"."competition_turns"."item_id" is not null and "missao_saber"."competition_turns"."item" is not null and "missao_saber"."competition_turns"."lesson_id" is not null and "missao_saber"."competition_turns"."puzzle_id" is null) or ("missao_saber"."competition_turns"."kind" = 'challenge' and "missao_saber"."competition_turns"."puzzle_id" is not null and "missao_saber"."competition_turns"."item_id" is null)

missao_competition_counts.name: missao_competition_counts
missao_competition_counts.value: "missao_saber"."competitions"."problem_count" between 0 and 20 and "missao_saber"."competitions"."challenge_count" between 0 and 3 and "missao_saber"."competitions"."problem_count" + "missao_saber"."competitions"."challenge_count" > 0

recreio_device_sessions_account.name: recreio_device_sessions_account
recreio_device_sessions_account.value: "recreio"."device_sessions"."kind" <> 'account' or ("recreio"."device_sessions"."auth_session_id" is not null and "recreio"."device_sessions"."user_id" is not null)

recreio_entitlements_revoke_reason.name: recreio_entitlements_revoke_reason
recreio_entitlements_revoke_reason.value: "recreio"."entitlements"."revoke_reason_code" is null or ("recreio"."entitlements"."revoked_at" is not null and "recreio"."entitlements"."revoke_reason_code" ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{2,40}$')

recreio_game_sessions_ended.name: recreio_game_sessions_ended
recreio_game_sessions_ended.value: ("recreio"."game_sessions"."ended_at" is null and "recreio"."game_sessions"."end_reason" is null and "recreio"."game_sessions"."ended_seq" is null) or ("recreio"."game_sessions"."ended_at" is not null and "recreio"."game_sessions"."end_reason" is not null and "recreio"."game_sessions"."ended_seq" is not null)

recreio_space_snapshots_storage.name: recreio_space_snapshots_storage
recreio_space_snapshots_storage.value: ("recreio"."space_snapshots"."storage" = 'pg' and "recreio"."space_snapshots"."data" is not null and "recreio"."space_snapshots"."object_key" is null) or ("recreio"."space_snapshots"."storage" = 'bucket' and "recreio"."space_snapshots"."object_key" is not null and "recreio"."space_snapshots"."data" is null)
